title: Draw a status icon that can be cleared
goal: uses Canvas 2D's fillRect and clearRect, and distinguishes canvas coordinates.
summary: device indicator needs to draw a green square inside the canvas, and can also be cleared by pressing the button. There is samplePixel to help observe actual pixels.
tasks: When #draw is clicked, a 32×24 solid color rectangle is drawn starting from coordinates (16, 12) with the color #125a46.
Clears the entire canvas and restores transparent pixels when #clear is clicked.

example.note: Canvas coordinates start from the upper left corner. fillRect reads fillStyle, clearRect restores the transparent pixels of the area.

hint: Remember to bind monitors to the two buttons respectively. The width and height of clearRect can come directly from canvas.
